description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 26.01.2015 - 01.02.2015
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, falls under legal/statutory instruments, and involves compliance requirements for international trade - all characteristics of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5).
